assessment: Larger than the initial PQ-08 estimate. This is a near-complete Personal Office shell — 19 files, ~106 KB — not a sketch. It includes a shell container, five routed pages, a command palette, a delegate composer, a work lane, and its own state/adapter layer with a feature flag and rollback path.

files.note: Command palettes are focus-trap and keyboard-nav sensitive. W2 must verify keyboard/focus, text zoom 200% and reduced motion per the Constitution's UI verification list.
Graph surfaces are Loop 04 ownership. This route is a shell-side wrapper; the graph itself is not W2's to change.

files.role: loading/empty/error/offline state handling — maps directly to the Constitution's required UI states

files.note: Typed against the legacy main/agent/types.ts because Loop 00/01 contracts did not exist when it was written. Must be retargeted onto shared/personal-office/ once Loop 01 is ACCEPTED. Its Loop-02-local ApprovalRequest is superseded by W3's work-approvals.ts plus W1's Approval contract.
Keeps legacy surfaces reachable — consistent with 'do not delete legacy before proof'.
Flag izzi.shell.personalOffice with a rollback path. This is what makes the shell landable without a big-bang cutover.

vaultAndWiki.note: Historical adjacent drafts found in shared/. Ownership was formally assigned to Loop 04 / W4 by gate PO-VAULT-OWNERSHIP. Loop 04 implemented and accepted the canonical vault/wiki contracts; these snapshot hashes remain provenance only and are not a source for later replay.

designDoc.note: Records the 5-route IA, the audience decision (one operator, not a multi-tenant console) and the primary workflow delegate → watch → approve → collect. Its own §0 states it could not inherit Loop 00/01 contracts because they did not exist, and it therefore typed against main/agent/types.ts. That section is now obsolete and must be rewritten against the accepted contracts, not deleted.

integrationWiring.note: Loop 02 is first owner, so this is W2's to take — but only under an explicit W0 lease, and only after Loop 01 is ACCEPTED. The quarantine draft modified it without a lease.
